page: Microsoft Azure E8-4ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Eadsv7 family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the E8-4ads_v7 includes a 472 GB NVMe SSD. It is also designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

Given its high memory density relative to the virtual CPU count, this instance provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. It is suited for database hosting, in-memory caching, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
